about: SCION 17 asset ledger: every piece in the film, where it came from, its rights, and the operation that made it.

cast_and_set_drawn_in_code.what: the dog: construction-paper cut-out, 3 body direction states (P profile, Q three-quarter, F front; P and Q also turned over as complete drawings), 5 head direction states (P, Q, F, QB, B), a standing drawing with a two-segment planted-foot leg rig and a lying drawing, expression atlas (eye OPEN/WIDE/HALF/CLOSED x brow NEUTRAL/WORRY/DOWN/UP x ear PRICK/HALF/FLAT), head stops, tail pivot
cast_and_set_drawn_in_code.operation: drawn: polygons cut in code from ovals, rounded strips and hulls, each with a fixed seeded scissor wobble (build/kit.py)

cast_and_set_drawn_in_code.what: the person: one three-quarter direction state, postures STAND/CROUCH/SIT, arm and leg pivots solved to hand and foot targets, face atlas (eyes, brows, head tilt) and a ten-shape mouth atlas
five spoken lines as timed phonemes; one table maps phonemes to mouth drawings and the same list drives the voice synthesizer

stage template: dusk sky bands, stars, clapboard house wall, two dark windows, porch fascia, post, floor, lattice skirt, steps, yard; the door in three drawings (AJAR, WIDE, OPEN) with the lit hall seen through it; the door light as a mask tied to the door drawing; two camera framings (WIDE, CLOSE)
a fixed paper grain multiplied over every frame
